steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.state.settings.autoQuality=false; g.setQuality('high'); g.dpr=1; g.renderer.setPixelRatio(1); g.resize(); g.bears.directorT=9999; const we=g.env.weather; we.cloud=0.2; we.cloudTarget=0.2; we.rain=0; we.rainTarget=0; we.timer=9999; g.hud.firstShown=-1000; g.hud.hint('',0); g.hud.show(false); __rhf.god(true); g.env.timeScale=0; g.player.tool='none'; g.viewmodel.setTool('none'); window.__face=async(id,tx,tz,time,pitch)=>{ const p=g.world.place(id); g.env.setTime(time); g.player.place(p.x,p.z,Math.atan2(-(tx-p.x),-(tz-p.z))); g.player.pitch=pitch; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,5000)); return id+' facing '+Math.round(Math.hypot(tx-p.x,tz-p.z))+' m'; }; return 'ok'})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const W=g.world; const cs=g.scenery.cascades; if(!cs.length) return 'no cascades'; let best=null; for(const c of cs){ const m=c.path[Math.floor(c.path.length/2)]; for(let k=0;k<36;k++){ const a=k/36*6.283; for(const d of [180,240,300,360]){ const x=m[0]+Math.cos(a)*d, z=m[2]+Math.sin(a)*d; if(!W.inBounds(x,z,10)||W.waterAt(x,z)) continue; const h=W.heightAt(x,z); if(h>m[1]-10) continue; let clear=true; for(let i=1;i<30;i++){ const q=i/30; const px=x+(m[0]-x)*q, pz=z+(m[2]-z)*q; if(W.heightAt(px,pz)>h+1.7+(m[1]+3-(h+1.7))*q) {clear=false;break;} } if(!clear) continue; const sc=c.drop-d*0.1; if(!best||sc>best.sc) best={c,m,x,z,h,d,sc}; } } } if(!best) return 'no clear view of a cascade'; const {c,m,x,z,h,d}=best; g.env.setTime(14); g.player.place(x,z,Math.atan2(-(m[0]-x),-(m[2]-z))); g.player.pitch=Math.atan2(m[1]-(h+1.7),d); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,5000)); return 'cascades '+cs.length+', showing one that drops '+Math.round(c.drop)+' m from '+d+' m'})()
